description: Classifies inbound documents as Virginia DMAS Health Insurance Premium Payment (HIPP) application material or unrelated content.

hipp-application.description: A Virginia DMAS HIPP application or HIPP correspondence form. It contains HIPP branding or a hipp_application heading, an Application ID, a Correspondence Type, policyholder information, household information, employment or insurance information, and HIPP agreement fields.

other.description: Any document that is not a HIPP application or HIPP correspondence form, including standalone paystubs, insurance cards, plan summaries, employer verification forms, correspondence, signature pages, or unrelated forms.
